pages.text: The Cell Serializer is the multiblock version of energy storage:$(br)place the serializer in the center and surround it with 26 Chi Energy Cells (any tier mixed) in a 3x3x3 to form the structure.$(br)Once formed, all cell capacities merge into a single storage: total = 1B (serializer) + 26 x cell capacity.$(br)Right-click any shell cell or the center to inspect; connect pipes to any shell to charge/discharge the whole array.
Example: 26 Super Cells (20B each) yield a total capacity of 521B.
